privacy.title: Kkeujeok Privacy Policy
privacy.storage.heading: Your notes stay in your Google Drive
privacy.storage.body: Notes are stored only in your own Google Drive. The operator cannot access your notes.
privacy.scope.heading: Permission we ask for
privacy.scope.body: Kkeujeok asks for one Google Drive permission, drive.file. It only works with files Kkeujeok created and cannot see other files in your Drive.
privacy.noserver.heading: Servers and data collection
privacy.noserver.body: Kkeujeok has no server. It uses no analytics and no crash reporting.
privacy.encryption.heading: Encryption
privacy.encryption.body: Kkeujeok does not separately encrypt the note files in your Drive.
privacy.revoke.heading: Disconnecting and revoking access
privacy.revoke.body: Disconnecting in Settings revokes Kkeujeok's Drive access. You can also revoke it at any time on your Google Account permissions page. Note files in your Drive stay as they are.
privacy.contact.heading: Contact
privacy.contact.body: Leave questions on the public issue page.

signin.denied.body: To save notes in the Kkeujeok folder of your Google Drive, access must be allowed. Kkeujeok can only see the files it creates.
